## Template Used

LACDR-ISA - Assay (General) v1.0.0

## Title

`r rmarkdown::metadata$title`

## Date (dd-MM-yyyy)

`r format(Sys.time(), format = "%d-%m-%Y")`

## Description or Purpose

Build Figure 2

### Background

### Data sources

-   Loadings and weights for Factor 1 from Figure 1
-   All transporters associated with top hits from Factor 1 from Recon3D
-   All export transporters from Recon3D
-   All transport-related genes from Reactome

### Analysis plan

-   A: all metabolite rates of interest without scaling/with zero as zero scaled to the max
-   B: transporters of interest and factor 1
-   C: correlation of all transporters reactome & link to factor 1 and 2
-   D: correlation of all transporters Recon3D & link to factor 1 and 2

## Results

### Preparations

#### Load R libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(cowplot)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```

#### Visualization settings for the report

```{r}
options(digits = 3) # visualizations of tables
theme_set(theme_classic())
```

#### Custom functions

```{r}
source(here("code/functions/helpers.R"))
source(here("code/functions/figure_helpers.R"))
source(here("code/functions/heatmap_helpers.R"))
source(here("code/functions/color_scales.R"))
```

#### Set input and output directories

Show base path to the project that is used in the analysis.

```{r}
here()
```

Set output data directory and create if it does not exist.

```{r}
datestamp <- get_datestamp()
output_dir <- set_output_dir(here("manuscript", str_glue("Figure2_{datestamp}")))
```

### Figure 2A

-   A: all metabolite rates of interest without scaling/with zero as zero scaled to the max

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
metabolite_rates <- read_csv(here(output_dir, "Figure2A.csv"))

# sort for plot order by factor 1 weight
metabolites_of_interest <- select(metabolite_rates, metabolite, weight_Factor1) |>
  distinct() |>
  filter(!is.na(weight_Factor1)) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(weight_Factor1)))

metabolite_rates |>
  mutate(metabolite = factor(metabolite,
    levels = metabolites_of_interest$metabolite
  )) |>
  filter(metabolite %in% metabolites_of_interest$metabolite) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Factor1, y = scaled_minmax_rate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~metabolite, scales = "free_y")
```

Prepare the data for plotting.

```{r}
metabolite_rates_heatmap <- metabolite_rates |>
  filter(metabolite %in% metabolites_of_interest$metabolite) |>
  select(metabolite, cell_line, scaled_minmax_rate) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = metabolite, names_from = cell_line, values_from = scaled_minmax_rate) |>
  column_to_rownames("metabolite")

metadata_cells <- metabolite_rates |>
  select(
    cell_line,
    Morphology, Subtype_4_categories, EMT_score, ProliferationRate,
    Factor1, Factor2
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Subtype = Subtype_4_categories) |>
  column_to_rownames("cell_line")

# Check that column order is identical
stopifnot(rownames(metadata_cells) == colnames(metabolite_rates_heatmap))
```

Define metadata colors of the factors

```{r}
ann_colors <- list(
  "Morphology" = color_legend_cell_lines[unique(metadata_cells$Morphology)] |> unlist(),
  "Subtype" = color_legend_Subtype,
  "EMT score" = add_numeric_colors(
    metadata_cells$EMT_score,
    color_legend_cell_lines$`Epithelial-like`,
    color_legend_cell_lines$`Mesenchymal-like`
  ),
  "Proliferation" = add_numeric_colors(metadata_cells$ProliferationRate, "white", "black"),
  "Factor 1" = add_numeric_colors(metadata_cells$Factor1, "white", "black"),
  "Factor 2" = add_numeric_colors(metadata_cells$Factor2, "white", "black")
)
```

Define the column annotation and plot the heatmap.

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
column_annotation <- columnAnnotation(
  "Subtype" = metadata_cells$Subtype,
  "Proliferation" = metadata_cells$ProliferationRate,
  "Factor 1" = metadata_cells$Factor1,
  col = ann_colors
)

figure_2a <- metabolite_rates_heatmap |>
  Heatmap(
    top_annotation = column_annotation,
    col = color_heatmap_cor,
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "scaled metabolite rate",
      direction = "horizontal"
    ),
    row_dend_width = unit(4, "mm"),
    column_dend_height = unit(4, "mm")
  ) |>
  draw(
    heatmap_legend_side = "bottom"
  )
figure_2a
```

### Figure 2B

-   B: transporters of interest and factor 1

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=4}
expression_factor1_hits <- read_csv(here(output_dir, "Figure2B.csv")) |>
  filter(!is.na(Factor1))
transporter_order <- unique(expression_factor1_hits$gene_symbol)
expression_factor1_hits <- expression_factor1_hits |>
  mutate(gene_symbol = factor(gene_symbol, levels = transporter_order))
length(unique(expression_factor1_hits$gene_symbol))

plot_transporters <- function(df, x_lab) {
  p <- df |>
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[x_lab]], y = log2_expression, color = Subtype_4_categories)) +
    geom_point(size = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~gene_symbol, scales = "free_y", nrow = 3) +
    # theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_legend_Subtype) +
    labs(color = "Subtype", x = x_lab, y = expression(log[2] ~ gene ~ expression)) +
    theme(
      legend.position = c(0.75, 0.2),
      legend.justification = "left"
    )
  return(p)
}

# Plot by factor
figure_2b <- plot_transporters(expression_factor1_hits, "Factor1")
figure_2b

# Plot by subtype
plot_transporters(expression_factor1_hits, "Subtype_4_categories")

# Plot by proliferation
plot_transporters(expression_factor1_hits, "ProliferationRate")
```

### Supplementary Figure

Transporters of interest in patient tissue

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=6}
transporter_data_pat <- read_csv(here(output_dir, "Figure2-Supplementary_Fig.csv"))

suppl_fig <- transporter_data_pat |>
  mutate(SUBTYPE = str_remove(SUBTYPE, "BRCA_")) |>
  # Sort by same order as cell line data
  mutate(Hugo_Symbol = factor(Hugo_Symbol, levels = transporter_order)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = SUBTYPE, y = log2_gene_expression, fill = design_group)) +
  geom_violin(draw_quantiles = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Hugo_Symbol, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  # theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = human_tissue_colors) +
  labs(
    fill = "Tissue type", x = NULL,
    y = expression(log[2] ~ gene ~ expression)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 90)) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.75, 0.2),
    legend.justification = "left"
  )

suppl_fig

save_plot(here(output_dir, "Supplementary_Figure_5.png"), suppl_fig)
```

### Figure 2C

-   C: correlation of all transporters Recon3D & link to factor 2

```{r}
t_transporters_pearson_cor <- read_csv(here(output_dir, "Figure2C.csv")) |>
  column_to_rownames("gene_symbol")

gene_EMT_cor <- read_csv(here(output_dir, "Figure2C_correlations.csv")) |>
  column_to_rownames("gene_symbol")

stopifnot(all(rownames(t_transporters_pearson_cor) == rownames(gene_EMT_cor)))

column_annotation <- columnAnnotation(
  df = select(gene_EMT_cor, ProliferationRate, EMT_score),
  col = list(
    ProliferationRate = purple_white_black,
    EMT_score = purple_white_black
  ),
  annotation_label = gt_render(c(
    "r<sub>s</sub> proliferation",
    "r<sub>s</sub> EMT score"
  )),
  show_legend = c(FALSE, FALSE)
)

(figure_2c <- t_transporters_pearson_cor |>
  Heatmap(
    col = color_heatmap_cor,
    top_annotation = column_annotation,
    show_row_names = FALSE,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "r"
    )
    # proliferation label fell off the figure.
    # Increase padding on the right to keep the labels:
  ) |> 
    draw(padding = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 5), "mm")))
figure_2c
```

### Figure 2D

-   D: correlation of all transporters Reactome & link to factor 2

```{r}
t_transporters_pearson_cor <- read_csv(here(output_dir, "Figure2D.csv")) |>
  column_to_rownames("gene_symbol")
gene_EMT_cor <- read_csv(here(output_dir, "Figure2D_correlations.csv")) |>
  column_to_rownames("gene_symbol")

stopifnot(all(rownames(t_transporters_pearson_cor) == rownames(gene_EMT_cor)))

column_annotation <- columnAnnotation(
  df = select(gene_EMT_cor, ProliferationRate, EMT_score),
  col = list(
    ProliferationRate = purple_white_black,
    EMT_score = purple_white_black
  ),
  annotation_label = gt_render(c(
    "r<sub>s</sub> proliferation",
    "r<sub>s</sub> EMT score"
  )),
  show_legend = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    title = gt_render("r<sub>s</sub>")
  )
)

figure_2d <- t_transporters_pearson_cor |>
  Heatmap(
    col = color_heatmap_cor,
    top_annotation = column_annotation,
    show_row_names = FALSE,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "r"
    )
  )
figure_2d
```

### Figure 2

```{r fig.height=18/2.54, fig.width=18/2.54}
figure_2 <- plot_grid(
  plot_grid(
    heatmap_in_grid(figure_2a),
    figure_2b,
    rel_widths = c(2, 1),
    labels = LETTERS[1:2]
  ),
  plot_grid(
    heatmap_in_grid(figure_2c),
    heatmap_in_grid(figure_2d),
    rel_widths = c(1, 1.1),
    labels = LETTERS[3:4]
  ),
  nrow = 2,
  rel_heights = c(1.1, 1)
)
figure_2
```

```{r}
(output_file <- here(output_dir, "Figure_2.png"))
save_plot(output_file, figure_2, base_height = page_height, base_width = page_width)
```
